context: Reference cleanup: comparator composition replacing a block comparator lambda.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates ShiftOrdering.java with the method, the nested record, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves the order
checklist.description: Orders by day, then start time, then lead with null leads last, then slots ascending; returns a new list and leaves the input untouched.

checklist.name: Composes JDK comparators
checklist.description: Uses Comparator.comparing(...).thenComparing(...) composition (with Comparator.nullsLast for the lead) instead of a block comparator lambda with if/else chains.

checklist.name: Uses the primitive comparator for slots
checklist.description: Uses thenComparingInt(Shift::slots) rather than a boxed comparing(Shift::slots) or a manual Integer.compare lambda.

checklist.name: Keeps callbacks as glue
checklist.description: Every comparator key is a method reference or one-expression lambda; no block lambda remains.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, sorting-algorithm changes, extra public API, or dependency changes.

metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: The runtime comparator-composition example was written after this scenario failed with context, so the two share the day-then-nullable-then-int shape; the scenario therefore counts as focused coverage of that example, never as ordinary lift.
